root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The declaring member's package.json, relative to its root

name.description: The dependency's key in that field

targetPath.description: The package.json of the workspace member the dependency names, a structural fact and never an install outcome: for a `workspace:` path, `file:` or `link:`, the member at that directory; for anything else, the member whose `name` is the dependency's name (`npm:<name>@` and pnpm's `workspace:<name>@` name `<name>`), the root only where the manager lets a name reach it. No version is checked and no registry, catalog or link setting is read. Null when it names no one member: no member carries the name, two do (WORKSPACE_DUPLICATE_NAME), the path holds no member (WORKSPACE_PATH_UNRESOLVED), a member of unknown name may be it (WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN), or the answer depends on an unknown manager (WORKSPACE_MANAGER_UNKNOWN)

protocol.description: `workspace`: a `workspace:` range; `catalog`: a `catalog:` range; `link` and `file`: a `link:` or `file:` path; `npm`: anything else (a semver range, a tag, an `npm:` alias, a git or tarball URL). The protocol as written, so a check can judge policy over it: VAT does not decide what an install would make of it

projection-workspace-dependencies.description: A row of the derived `workspace_dependencies` relation
